newsitem.title: USA: CenterPoint adds to property portfolio.
newsitem.headline: CenterPoint adds to property portfolio.

text.p: CenterPoint Properties Corp said Wednesday it added 794,426 square feet to its industrial property portfolio, bringing its total portfolio to about 17 million square feet.

The real estate investment trust acquired a 300,000 square foot building in Waukegan and a 243,350 square foot project consisting of four separate 28-foot clear masonry construction industrial warehouse buildings in West Allis, Wis.
It also simultaneously announced the groundbreaking on the 251,076 square foot Phase II of a development as a build-to-suit for a soon-to-be-named tenant.
CenterPoint further reported two dispositons, including the $4.5 million sale of a 72,022 square foot building in Atlanta, Ga. and the $4.8 million sale of a mortgage investment in Bedford Park, Ill.
